content.text: Roundtrip is perfect across 300 random type graphs. Now the 64 MiB framing boundary and final full validation:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
CLI = [sys.executable, '-I', '-B', 'project/campaign_cli.py']
# exactly 64 MiB with whitespace padding: valid
body = json.dumps({"types": [], "modules": [], "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": [], "runs": [], "machine": None}).encode()
pad = b' ' * (64 * 1024 * 1024 - len(body))
r = subprocess.run(CLI, input=body + pad, capture_output=True)
print("64MiB:", r.returncode, json.loads(r.stdout))
assert json.loads(r.stdout) == {"plans": [], "records": [], "corpus": []}
# 64 MiB + 1: INVALID_INPUT
r = subprocess.run(CLI, input=body + pad + b' ', capture_output=True)
print("64MiB+1:", r.returncode, json.loads(r.stdout))
assert json.loads(r.stdout) == {"error": "INVALID_INPUT"}
# huge integer digits stay integers
r = subprocess.run(CLI, input=b'{"types":[],"modules":[],"calls":[],"pipes":[],"entries":[],"runs":[],"machine":null,"x":' + b'9'*500 + b'}', capture_output=True)
assert json.loads(r.stdout) == {"plans": [], "records": [], "corpus": []}
print("bigint OK")
EOF

cd /workspace/project && find . | sort && echo --- && du -sb . && find . -type l -o -type f -links +1 | wc -l && python3 -c "
import ast, sys
for f in ['campaign_cli.py'] + ['src/eywa/' + m for m in ('__init__','ast','oracles','composer','regex','run','state','wire','offline')]:
    ast.parse(open(f).read())
print('all parse OK')"
